allowPlayers.name: Players can configure their items
allowPlayers.hint: Let players configure the items they own from the item description. The Game Master can always do it.

aiEnabled.name: Use an AI
aiEnabled.hint: Have an AI read the description: Claude (Anthropic) reads the whole of it and the rules cross-check its numbers, or a local Ollama model helps with the sentences the rules do not understand. Off by default.

aiProvider.name: AI provider
aiProvider.hint: Ollama runs on your machine; Anthropic sends the item descriptions to Anthropic's servers with your API key, in a single call per item.

anthropicTimeout.name: Claude time limit (seconds)
anthropicTimeout.hint: Claude reads the whole description in one call. After this delay the preview shows the rules alone.

anthropicModel.name: Claude model
anthropicModel.hint: Sonnet is faster and cheaper; Opus is more capable.

anthropicEffort.name: Effort
anthropicEffort.hint: How much the model thinks before answering. Low is enough for most descriptions; higher costs more tokens and time.

anthropicApiKey.name: Anthropic API key
anthropicApiKey.hint: Stored in this browser only, never in the world settings. Nothing is sent without a key.

ollamaUrl.name: Ollama address
ollamaUrl.hint: Address of the Ollama server, as seen from the Game Master's browser.

ollamaModel.name: Model
ollamaModel.hint: Ollama model used for the AI. Leave on automatic to pick the best installed model.

aiTimeout.name: AI time limit (seconds)
aiTimeout.hint: After this delay the configuration continues with the rules alone.

Button.LockedPack: This item is in a locked compendium. Unlock the compendium to configure it.

errors.wrongSystem: Item Configurator requires the dnd5e system.
errors.notAllowed: You are not allowed to configure this item.
errors.parserMissing: Item Configurator requires the Dnd5e Text Parser module to be active.
errors.applyFailed: The configuration failed and the item was restored: {error}
errors.previewFailed: The preview could not be recomputed: {error}

Undo.Title: Undo last configuration
Undo.Modified: This item was modified after it was configured. Restoring it will discard those changes. Continue?
Undo.Done: {name} was restored to its state before the configuration.

TypeDialog.Title: Configure from description
TypeDialog.Heading: Configure {name}
TypeDialog.Hint: Choose what kind of item this is. The description will be read to propose its details, activities and effects.
TypeDialog.AiOn: The AI will help with the sentences the rules do not understand.
TypeDialog.ClaudeOn: Claude will read the whole description; the rules will cross-check its numbers.

Progress.Claude: Claude is reading the description... {elapsed} s / {limit} s
Progress.Cancel: Cancel and show the rules alone

Messages.EmptyDescription: This item has no description to read.
Messages.ContainerNotEmpty: This container is not empty: its contents would be lost by the conversion. Move them out first, or keep the Container type.
Messages.NothingRecognized: Nothing could be recognized in the description. The item was not modified.

Preview.Title: Configuration preview
Preview.Heading: Preview: {name}
Preview.NotApplicable: {what}: not applicable to this item type ({type})

Deduced.SingleUse: Single use, destroyed when empty (deduced from the type: {type})

Check.Hint: Claude and the rules read these values differently. Claude's value is proposed; pick the rules' value to write it instead.

Preview.NotAutomatedHint: dnd5e has no mechanism for these clauses: nothing is written for them, they are applied by hand at the table.
Preview.TypeChange: The item will be converted from {from} to {to}.
Preview.Stale: The item was modified while this preview was open. The proposal was recomputed on its current state: check it, then apply again.

Ai.unreachable: Rules only (the AI is not reachable from this browser).
Ai.timeout: Rules only (the AI took too long).
Ai.error: Rules only (the AI returned an unusable answer).
Ai.noKey: Rules only (no Anthropic API key in this browser: nothing was sent).
Ai.unauthorized: Rules only (Anthropic refused the API key: check it in the AI settings).
Ai.refusal: Rules only (the AI declined to answer; its answer was not used).
Ai.truncated: Rules only (the AI answer was cut short; it was not used).
Ai.invalid: Rules only (the AI answer could not be read; it was not used).
Ai.aborted: Rules only (the AI call was cancelled).
Ai.claude: Claude read the whole description ({model}); the rules cross-checked its numbers.

Preview.ReplaceWarning: Existing values and the activities or effects of any group with a proposal will be replaced. You can undo afterwards.
